problems.description: Check the ones that sound like you. One is enough to get us started.
items: You have an idea you want to build.
Processes that are still done by hand.
Systems that don't talk to each other.
Repetitive tasks eating up your day.
You have a half-built product that won't ship.
problems.ctaTitle: Checked one? Tell us which and we'll start there.

services.title: What we build.
services.description: Four things, depending on the problem you have today. On their own or combined.

items.title: Internal tools
items.description: Dashboards, portals and platforms built for how your team already works.
highlights: Everyone sees only what they need

items.title: Automation
items.description: We connect the tools you already use and take the manual work off your plate.

items.title: Artificial intelligence
items.lead: AI that does the work, not the demo.
items.description: Agents and assistants with one concrete job: read documents, answer, load, sort.

items.title: Products and websites
items.description: Websites, apps and MVPs that go live. Ideas are cheap. Finished things are not.

steps.title: First call
steps.description: You tell us the problem or the idea. You talk to the people who will build it.

steps.title: Written proposal
steps.description: What's in, what's out, what it costs and how long it takes. All clear before we start.

steps.title: Progress every week
steps.description: You see something working every week, not a report at the end.

steps.title: We ship
steps.description: It goes live and you use it. Then we improve it with real usage.

faq.title: What people ask before writing to us.
faq.imageAlt: Illustration of construction cranes in orange tones on a pink background

items.question: I don't know what I need, can we still talk?
items.answer: Yes. Most projects start exactly like this. Tell us the problem and we'll figure out together what's worth building.

items.question: How much does it cost and how long does it take?
items.answer: It depends on the scope. On the first call we look at it together and send you a price and a timeline in writing before anything starts. After that, you see progress every week, not a report at the end.

items.question: I already have a tech team, can you join it?
items.answer: Yes. We can take on part of the product or add hands to your team for a defined period, with the scope in writing like any other project.

items.question: Do you work with clients outside Argentina?
items.answer: Yes. We work in Spanish and English, and everything happens over video calls, on your schedule.

events.description: We're building our first events: build nights, meetups, hackathons, talks and whatever else we come up with. We're starting in Santa Fe, then taking it across the country.
events.sponsorTitle: Want to sponsor or help us organize?
